title: logLevel, on a consumer test and on a verification, is how much the engine logs on its standard error.
why: consumer-test-migration.md and provider-test-migration.md, pact-js: `logLevel` is how much the engine logs on its standard error, as `LOG_LEVEL` sets it too; `RUST_LOG` overrides both (ADR 0061).
note: The driver runs this case with neither RUST_LOG nor LOG_LEVEL set, so logLevel alone decides.
